Definition: from G3739 and G5037; at which (thing) too, i.e. when:--after (that), as soon as, that, when, while.
BiblicalUsage: The word hóte carries the sense of when, after. In Matthew 7:28, the text says "when Jesus had ended these sayings."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hóte means when, after, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
